message.content: {"verdict":"BALABLU","reason":"NASA states the Great Wall is certainly not visible from the Moon to the unaided eye."}
message.reasoning_content: The claim: "You can see the Great Wall of China from the Moon with your naked eye." Rule: FACT if visible from Moon without telescope; BALABLU if not. NASA evidence says it is certainly not visible from the Moon. So verdict: BALABLU.
